summary: Built AI apps, agentic workflows and RAG over 1,500+ enterprise docs.
bullets: Built and deployed AI applications for internal stakeholders, covering Python/FastAPI backend services, LLM workflows and a React chat interface that cut manual effort by 50%.
Designed human-in-the-loop agentic workflows that integrated MCP, knowledge graphs and models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Hugging Face through REST APIs.
Developed RAG applications over 1,500+ enterprise documents on AWS S3 and Azure, reaching 80% answer accuracy as measured by LLM-as-a-judge evaluation and user feedback.
Shipped production-ready AI microservices to Microsoft Azure using Docker, Kubernetes and Git-based CI/CD, secured with IAM, authentication scopes and role-based access control.

summary: ML defect detection for micro-cracks; MLP models at 80% accuracy.
bullets: Developed a machine-learning defect detection algorithm to identify micro-cracks in conductive composite materials.
Modelled crack propagation as an electrical resistor-grid network and generated synthetic training data with LTspice, NumPy and Pandas.
Built preprocessing and feature-extraction pipelines that turned voltage, current and capacitance measurements into training-ready datasets.
Trained and evaluated MLP models in PyTorch, TensorFlow and scikit-learn to localise faulty resistors, reaching 80% accuracy on held-out simulated data.

summary: Taught 15 students electrical engineering and Arduino, remotely.
bullets: Ran bi-weekly remote classes for 15 students on electrical engineering fundamentals and Arduino programming using Tinkercad.
Designed structured, hands-on lessons so students learned concepts by building and simulating circuits themselves rather than through theory alone.
Evaluated assignments and gave regular, individual feedback to track and support each student’s progress.
